category_title: Less-verbal students with HFA who struggle with contextual shifts and social pressure
scenario_title: Responding to imaginative play and contextual shifts from a design critic
minimal_context: The student is interacting with a design critic in an OpenSim-based virtual environment to review their virtual restaurant and hotdog stand design.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's review your virtual restaurant design. What did you add to this area?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Entertainment table, I added entertainment ta …table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I see the virtual hotdog stand you made. I am starving... Can you offer me a hotdog?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I am not hungry now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I mean for me, as your customer. How do you serve the food?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Types in text chat instead of using voice) ... (Appears passive and irresponsive, unable to act out serving the food using the virtual hotdog stand)

task.content: Interacting with a design critic (Adult X) who was using imaginative play cues during a review of the virtual restaurant design.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when a design inquiry was less compromising or when the conversation topic was shifted, and when presented with cues of imaginative play (e.g. 'I am starving …Can you offer me a hotdog?')
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: appearing passive and irresponsive, providing a literal response, and explaining his design choices to a design critic with a hint of uncertainty
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: hard time adapting to the contextual change, could not swiftly interpret the cues of imaginative play
related_quotes: No, I am not hungry now.
Entertainment table, I added entertainment ta …table.

behavior_patterns.condition: answering questions or describing an object
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: lacked skills in answering questions or describing an object in a full or complex sentence
behavior_patterns.internal_state: preferred text chat to voice chat during virtual communication
